dedupe_keys.name: oil and gas commodity data conventional and non conventional marketable production and values for canada provinces and territories 2013

description: Two customised Statistics Canada packages report 2012 and 2013 marketable oil-and-gas production and values for Canada, provinces and territories. Listed commodities include crude and synthetic oil, natural gas, condensate, crude bitumen, pentanes plus, propane, butanes and ethane. The conventional-sector tables include Alberta royalty allocation, provincial/territorial principal statistics and net cash expenditures. Non-conventional tables include Alberta value added and expenditures. Each annual package has one XLSX descriptor. These are energy-extraction throughput and financial measures; detailed units, industry reporting scope and numerical values remain unspecified. The two years are grouped as editions of the same named statistical product, without an assertion that every field is identical. Geographic coverage is Canada, with source-specific Alberta, provincial, western Canadian or United States comparisons as described. The Canadian Urban Data Catalogue preserves the source identifiers and descriptive metadata. The native licence is Open Government Licence - Alberta. Access is labelled unrestricted but isopen is false; actual payload access and costs remain unverified. No linked dataset, workbook, document, legal text, model or code body was retrieved. Specific simulation applications beyond those explicitly described are not established.
